name: Fortra-Originated partner band
expected: Deal_Type__c='Fortra Originated', partner discount should resolve from Non_Orig_Software_Pct__c column (e.g. 12% for PPM-00028 vs 15% channel), Net = List x (1 - Non_Orig_Discount%)
actual: Quote 0Q0WC0000039bwH0AQ (Deal_Type__c='Fortra Originated', PartnerAccount='AB Test Partner Account', PPM-00028, BoKS Perpetual). After Force-reprice on live V21 (isSuccess=true, no errors): BoKS Perpetual QLI (0QLWC000003eoAr4AI) Qty=1, ListPrice=355, NetUnitPrice=301.75 = 355 x 0.85 (15% channel column Software_Percent__c). Partner_Pricing_Source__c='System Calculated (Pre-Procedure, Percent Only)'. Deal_Type has ZERO effect: active prehook PartnerPricingPrehook V1 calls PartnerPricingService.getMarginForProductType(model, productType) with NO dealType argument and reads only Software_Percent__c. The Non_Orig routing exists only in the DORMANT PartnerPricingServiceV2.getMarginForProductType(model, productType, dealType). evidence: Fortra-Orig quote: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC0000039bwH0AQ/view ; QLI 0QLWC000003eoAr4AI NetUnitPrice=301.75=355*0.85 ; REST place /services/data/v67.0/connect/rev/sales-transaction/actions/place isSuccess:true errorResponse:[] ; Live PartnerPricingService.getMarginForProductType signature has 2 args (model, productType) — no dealType — reads Software_Percent__c unconditionally ; PartnerPricingServiceV2.getMarginForProductType has 3 args (model, productType, dealType) with Non_Orig routing but class is dormant (not wired into V21 procedure); SOQL COUNT on Partner_Pricing_Model__c WHERE Non_Orig_Software_Pct__c != null = 0 (all 30 rows null) ; Channel-Orig control E-02 quote 0Q0WC000003FO1u0AG also reads same channel column via same V1 prehook — confirming deal-type blindness is structural
defectStep: Not a V21 procedure step. Defect is in the Apex partner prehook layer that feeds PartnerDiscountPercent into V21: active processor = PartnerPricingPrehook V1 -> PartnerPricingService.getMarginForProductType(model, productType) is Deal_Type-blind (reads channel columns only). V21 'Partner Discount' / 'Resolve Partner Discount Percent' steps merely consume the pre-stamped PDP. Compounded by empty Non_Orig_* config on all 30 PPM rows.
proposedFix: Two-part fix required: (1) Replace active PartnerPricingPrehook V1 with V2 (or upgrade V1 to pass dealType to getMarginForProductType, routing to Non_Orig_* columns when Deal_Type__c='Fortra Originated'). (2) Populate Non_Orig_Software_Pct__c / Non_Orig_Subscription_Pct__c / Non_Orig_New_Maint_Pct__c / Non_Orig_Ren_Maint_Pct__c / Non_Orig_Services_Pct__c on all relevant Partner_Pricing_Model__c records per the Fortra partner tier schedule. Neither fix alone is sufficient.
notes: Re-measured on V21 ACTIVE as of 2026-06-30 (ExpressionSetDefinitionVersion 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY). Preflight passed: quote is UI-built (not headless), CalculationStatus=CompletedWithPricing, valid active PPM-00028 (Software_Percent__c=15 non-zero), BoKS Perpetual List=355 (non-zero), PBE active on Fortra Price Book USD. Deal_Type__c='Fortra Originated' confirmed on quote header. PartnerAccount='AB Test Partner Account' (001WC00000ZtazZYAR). Branch confirmed via Partner_Pricing_Source__c='System Calculated (Pre-Procedure, Percent Only)' = V1 prehook marker. Smoke-tested on real UI-hydrated records — no headless artifact risk. Distinct from E-03/SC-3359 (One-Time net zeroing) — here the CHANNEL percent IS applied, it is just the wrong (channel) percent for a Fortra-Originated deal. Consistent with run1 finding. New-Maint derived line (0QLWC000003eoAs4AI) nets 60.35 = 355*0.17 (NewMaint 20% of list - 15% partner discount carried forward), also using channel column.
verdict_reason: Force-reprice through live V21 (isSuccess=true) on UI-built Fortra-Originated partner Discount quote stamped NetUnitPrice=301.75=355*0.85 (15% channel discount). Expected behavior for Deal_Type='Fortra Originated' is to use the Non_Orig band (e.g. 12%), producing a lower discount. The active PartnerPricingPrehook V1 is Deal_Type-blind and all 30 PPM rows have Non_Orig_* columns null. Both defects are org-config-level (prehook version not promoted + PPM data not populated) rather than a V21 procedure step defect.
